declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this declaration on behalf of Ostrander Bell LLP in support of preliminary approval. In the first and only negotiation round, our firm proposed a $32 million class fund with automatic payments to identified class members, plus $5 million in attorneys’ fees and expenses paid separately by Brightline, subject to court approval. Our proposal provided that Brightline would not agree to refrain from opposing the fee request and that any fees not awarded would go to the class. Defense counsel accepted that proposal without a counteroffer. We proposed class relief and fees together; it would be inaccurate to say fees were discussed only after class relief was agreed. The complete negotiation transcript is being filed as ordered. We recognize that our contingent fee and the overlapping class actions create potential incentives for counsel to favor a settlement. The court should evaluate the class recovery and fee request independently.
